name: Mad Dental Care Teeth Whitening Powder | Dentist Approved Enamel-Safe Natural Formula
description:
Brighten your smile with Mad Dental™ Teeth Whitening Powder, a dentist-approved and enamel-safe formula designed for daily use. This natural whitening powder effectively lifts stains from coffee, tea, wine, and smoking without causing sensitivity or damage. Gentle yet powerful, it promotes a cleaner, healthier mouth and leaves your teeth looking visibly brighter with every use.
Key Features
 Dentist-approved, enamel-safe whitening formula
 Removes stains from coffee, tea, wine & smoking
 Gentle on gums, no sensitivity caused
 Natural ingredients for daily safe use
 Promotes oral freshness and hygiene
 Easy-to-use powder for visible results
Ingredients / Materials
Natural whitening agents, enamel-safe cleansing formula, oral-care minerals
How to Use
 Wet toothbrush with water
 Dip into a small amount of powder
 Brush teeth gently for 2–3 minutes
 Rinse mouth & brush thoroughly
 Use 1–2 times daily for best results
Package Includes
 1 × Mad Dental Care Teeth Whitening Powder
